applicabilityBasis.summary: YUSD is marketed as a 1:1 USD digital dollar and is integrated with wallets, exchanges, and card infrastructure, but it is BTC-backed, yield-bearing, and rewards holders through a delta-neutral funding strategy. Whether that synthetic yield product is a GENIUS payment stablecoin remains unresolved. The reviewed public materials do not establish a token-specific legal issuer obligation to redeem YUSD for a fixed amount of monetary value, as required by Section 2(22).

genius.notes: Aegis describes YUSD as a BTC-backed, delta-neutral, yield-bearing dollar product. Public mint access is KYC/whitelist-restricted and accepts USDT, USDC and DAI; the opened product pages do not establish a public fixed monetary-value redemption obligation. A public Accountable collateral/liability dashboard is available, but its signed reserve snapshots do not establish a monthly independent reserve attestation. Archived June 13, 2025 service terms identify Aegis Vault Ltd. (British Virgin Islands) and separately Aegis DAO Foundation (Cayman Islands); current legal pages returned HTTP 403, so issuerEntity and issuerDomicile remain omitted pending current token-specific attribution. No public GENIUS PPSI approval, official application, state qualification, foreign exception registration or token-specific enforcement action was located in the sources checked on October 7, 2026. The OCC digital-assets table is a limited pending charter-application list, not a complete GENIUS approval register; NYDFS licenses are not GENIUS approvals. Treasury's August 17 proposal anticipates a January 18, 2027 general effective date and a July 18, 2028 DASP offer/sale restriction; neither future milestone establishes a present prohibition. The prior informational-not-public-offer assertion is removed because it was not re-established on the current homepage.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public Aegis/YUSD PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, official GENIUS application or registered/comparable foreign-issuer exception was located as of October 7, 2026 in the bounded regulator records and searches above. The OCC pending charter table and NYDFS licensing list do not constitute complete GENIUS authorization registers; their negative results are limited to those publications. Archived generic terms identify a BVI company, but current token-specific issuer attribution and a fixed monetary redemption obligation remain unresolved. No token-specific GENIUS enforcement action was found in the reviewed records or targeted searches. These negative findings do not establish illegality, a legal exemption, or absence from every possible regulatory record.
